description: Askari General Insurance Company Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is a public limited company listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, supervised by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan. It underwrites general insurance across health, motor, fire, marine, travel, engineering, bond, aviation and miscellaneous lines, offers vehicle tracker services, and runs a window takaful operation. PACRA and VIS both assign it an insurer financial strength rating of AA+ (IFS).
headOffice: 3rd Floor, AWT Plaza, The Mall, Rawalpindi, Pakistan
